GoogleLabs.en:
Have you explored Project Genie yet? 🌎 We just launched a huge set of updates! You can now simulate worlds grounded in @GoogleMaps Street View, manage your creations in a new library, and share them externally. Let's dive in:

1️⃣ Street View Grounding: You can now generate worlds starting from real places! Just tap the Maps pin to choose a location in the US and you can pick a style like "Desert Sands" or "Ocean World." Describe your character, and Genie ties your starting location to real-world imagery.

2️⃣ Library: You can now store and organize your generated worlds. Easily explore past creations or remix your favorites to iterate on your ideas.

3️⃣ External sharing: You can now share your generated worlds. Anyone can watch a video preview of your world, and Ultra subscribers can explore or remix them. Check out a shared world here: 

✨ And now, Project Genie is gradually rolling out to all eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers globally (18+). Jump in and start creating today!
GoogleLabs.zh:
您探索过 Project Genie 了吗？ 🌎 我们刚刚推出了大量更新！您现在可以模拟基于 @GoogleMaps Street View 的世界，在新库中管理您的创作，并在外部共享它们。让我们深入探讨：

1️⃣ 街景基础：您现在可以从真实的地方开始生成世界！只需点击地图图钉即可选择美国的位置，然后您就可以选择“沙漠金沙”或“海洋世界”等样式。描述您的角色，Genie 会将您的起始位置与现实世界的图像联系起来。

2️⃣ 图书馆：您现在可以存储和组织您生成的世界。轻松探索过去的创作或重新混合您最喜欢的作品以迭代您的想法。

3️⃣ 外部共享：您现在可以共享您生成的世界。任何人都可以观看您的世界的视频预览，Ultra 订阅者可以探索或重新混合它们。在这里查看共享世界： 

✨ 现在，Project Genie 正在逐步向全球所有符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅者（18 岁以上）推出。今天就加入并开始创作吧！

levie.en:
Token costs will become a dominant topic in enterprises going forward with AI. Just got out of a dinner with many Fortune 500 enterprise CIOs and this was the most heated topic. 

A mix of strategies are being employed, but basically no one feels like they have the right solution. A mix of: figuring out how to prioritize workloads to different models, giving out access to better or worse agents by user type, setting different spend caps by team, having teams justify AI by their use-case, and some just having unfettered access.

Everyone is trying to figure out a semi/predictable model right now in a world where the underlying tech and cost models are constantly evolving.
levie.zh:
代币成本将成为企业推进人工智能的主要话题。刚和众多世界500强企业的CIO吃完饭，这是最热门的话题。 

人们正在采用多种策略，但基本上没有人觉得自己拥有正确的解决方案。包括：弄清楚如何对不同模型的工作负载进行优先级排序，根据用户类型授予更好或更差代理的访问权限，按团队设置不同的支出上限，让团队根据其用例证明人工智能的合理性，以及一些团队拥有不受限制的访问权限。

现在，在底层技术和成本模型不断发展的世界中，每个人都在试图找出一个半/可预测的模型。

mattturck.en:
Genuinely impressive release by Google today (remember when they were behind?)

Gemini 3.5 Flash perf:
* Building on prior strengths (83.6% of MMMU-Pro for multimodal), 
* big jump on agentic coding (76.2% on Terminal-Bench for agentic coding and 56.5% on Toolathon for real world tasks)
* progress and expert tasks (57.9% on Finance Agent 2... we are cooked)
* leading scores across SWE-Bench, OSWorld etc. 

(also, elegant to bold the top scores in the chart below even if when it's not Google leading)

Ofc, just benchmarks, and also not cheap  (~$9/M output), but Google is cookin'... we are all so spoiled to have the 3 labs compete
mattturck.zh:
谷歌今天发布了令人印象深刻的版本（还记得他们落后的时候吗？）

Gemini 3.5 闪存性能：
* 建立在先前的优势之上（多式联运的 MMMU-Pro 为 83.6%）， 
* 代理编码的大幅跃升（代理编码的 Terminal-Bench 为 76.2%，现实世界任务的 Toolathon 为 56.5%）
* 进度和专家任务（财务代理 2 上 57.9%...我们已经熟了）
* 在 SWE-Bench、OSWorld 等方面的领先分数 

（另外，即使不是谷歌领先，也可以优雅地将下表中的最高分加粗）

Ofc，只是基准测试，而且也不便宜（~$9/M 产出），但 Google 正在烹饪……我们都太喜欢让 3 个实验室竞争了

nikunj.en:
Even in the AI pilled crowd of the Bay Area, I think VERY few people have priced in the fact that we have already gone from assistant -> coworker -> and soon entering autonomous workers.. 

Yes, "autonomy" truly doesn't work yet, but the harnesses and the model capabilities are going to get us there within this area for a large faction of jobs.  

This is quite evident from a) labs desire to collect long horizon task data in RL environments b) these model harnesses allowing longer and longer tasks (see /goal or Droid Missions) and c) how good these models are able to recursively correct its mistakes. 

AI has officially entered the diffusion era (not diffusion models) where models just need to be diffused in everything they do. And that will take the next 10-20 years or as I call it the last mile of the last mile.
nikunj.zh:
即使在湾区的人工智能人群中，我认为也很少有人考虑到我们已经从助理 -> 同事 -> 很快进入自主工作者这一事实。 

是的，“自主性”确实还行不通，但线束和模型功能将使我们在这一领域完成大量工作。  

这从 a) 实验室希望在 RL 环境中收集长期任务数据 b) 这些模型利用允许越来越长的任务（参见 /goal 或 Droid Missions）以及 c) 这些模型能够递归地纠正其错误的能力来看，这一点非常明显。 

人工智能已经正式进入扩散时代（不是扩散模型），模型只需要在它们所做的一切中扩散。这将需要未来 10-20 年的时间，或者我称之为最后一英里的最后一英里。
